{{Quote|Abnormal species, emigrate. Operator restriction beyond this field.|Master Control|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Master Control''' was a piece of [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] technology constructed by the [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] race and stationed on the world of [[Asation]]. This machine mind was situated at the [[Hypergate]] Operation Center where it was responsible for the control of all the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces of the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]] on the planet. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Dread Masters]] dispatched their agent [[Kephess]] to sow chaos and terror in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. This saw the transformed [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] traveling to Asation where he commandeered the [[Grand Hypergate]] and brought numerous monstrous creatures as well as turned the planet's droid forces against their creators.

In desperation, the Gree dispatched envoys to both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in order to get the assistance of Black Bisectors. These spacers later battled the Master Control where they succeeded in shutting down the artificial intelligence which allowed them to proceed to battle Kephess.

==Behind the scenes==
The Master Control is the third encounter in the operation Terror from Beyond, part of the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' where it is referred to as Operator IX.

A [http://www.swtor.com/info/media/screens/asation screencap] at the ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' website seemingly identities the artificial intelligence as being called Master Control and responsible for control of all droids on Asation though this is not mentioned in-game.
